privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how your details are handled under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).
privacy.whatBody: Your name, phone number, address or town, the areas you want painted, your chosen colors and any photos you upload.
privacy.whyBody: Only to prepare and discuss a painting quote with you. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.whoBody: The painter and anyone they authorise. Photos are private and are never shown publicly.
privacy.keepBody: Requests are kept while we work with you and for a limited time afterwards. Photos you uploaded but did not send are deleted within a day.
privacy.rightsBody: You may ask to see, correct or delete your details at any time by contacting us on WhatsApp.
